connector.name: Nigeria Quidax Crypto
connector.registryDescription: Live crypto tickers in Naira (BTC/NGN etc.) from Quidax. Read-only, keyless, no trading.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package nigeria-mcp-quidax-crypto. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
